scope: Fixed normalized historical C1 research price units; not LIVE contract validation or a dated total-cost model
time_rule: Naive FINAM timestamps are Moscow open labels; available at t+15min. Exporter attestation is recorded in IntradayLab/reports/STAGE1_M5_CLOCK_CONFIRMATION.md at the pinned discovery base.

USDRUBF.basis: Explicit historical reproduction requirement; historical TradingSystemLab/core/instrument_specs.py price_precision. Not the exchange tick.

CNYRUBF.basis: Explicit historical reproduction requirement; historical TradingSystemLab/core/instrument_specs.py price_precision. Not a dated exchange-tick cost model.

GLDRUBF.confirmed_launch_terms: MOEX announcement dated 2023-07-10: one gram, price step 0.1 RUB, tick value 0.1 RUB
GLDRUBF.archive_doc_access: Web tool returned Unsupported content-type application/msword; full text not attested

IMOEXF.confirmed_launch_terms: MOEX announcement dated 2023-11-10: quote in points, price step 0.5 points, tick value 5 RUB; hence 10 RUB per point
IMOEXF.archive_doc_access: Web tool returned Unsupported content-type application/msword for all three; full texts not attested

gate_b_rule: Launch-announcement units independently establish the fixed research C1 scale; every historical OHLC must pass its Decimal grid. These checks permit a normalized C1 baseline only. Unavailable full contract editions prevent claims about exhaustive dated exchange terms or complete economic costs.
r_normalization: R = signed(exit-entry)/abs(entry-initial_stop); C1_R = 2*price_unit/abs(entry-initial_stop). Multiplying numerator and denominator by RUB-per-point cancels; IMOEXF 10 RUB round-trip/(10*initial_price_risk) = 1/initial_price_risk.
limitations: No funding, dividend adjustment, ordinary fees, additional spread/slippage, margin, contract sizing or observed fills are included
Si/CNY and new-instrument units have different historical research provenance; aggregate R is descriptive, not a capital-weighted portfolio
Stops and trailing prices remain continuous as in the historical reference; they are not rounded executable orders
